name.zh: 受 Sengelia 启发的 K 形匍匐植物

description.en: Lay connected angular K-junctions close to the ground; use a few lifted shoots to show directional branching.
description.zh: 把连续K形节点贴地排列，以少量抬高枝条显示分枝方向。

sources.title: An organismal concept for Sengelia radicans
sources.supports: Whole-plant evidence for prostrate axes, K-branching and root-bearing shoots.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Nominal scale, color, pose and repeated detail counts are artistic choices; no exact species/specimen/coexistence reconstruction. Original geometry only.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 名义尺度、颜色、姿态及细小重复结构数量为美术选择；不主张精确物种、标本或同域共存复原。仅含原创几何。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
